how_to_apply: Download the prescribed Application Form from www.gmfc.ac.in.
Attach self-attested/certified true copies of marks secured from S.S.C. onwards.
Reserved-category applicants of Goan origin attach certificates issued by competent authorities of the state of Goa, valid on the date of submission.
Applications must reach the undersigned within 10 days from the publication of the advertisement.
Make sure it reaches by 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 Assistant Professor in IT & Computer Applications (Lecture Basis), 1 College Counsellor (Contract Basis).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GMFC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed Application Form on the college website www.gmfc.ac.in) and send it to Shri. Gopal Gaonkar Memorial Goa Multi-Faculty College, NH-4A, Ponda-Belgaum Road, Dayanand Nagar, Dharbandora, South Goa, 403406, by post or in person, to reach by 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As laid down by the Goa University/Government of Goa and other statutory bodies for Assistant Professor in IT & Computer Applications (Lecture Basis), As laid down by the Goa University/Government of Goa and other statutory bodies for College Counsellor (Contract Basis).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor: Master's degree with at least 55% marks in a concerned/relevant/allied subject plus NET/SET or Ph.D. as per Goa University Statute SC-16.4. College Counsellor: Master in Psychology/Human Development/Master of Arts (Wellness Counselling) with 55% marks in aggregate. Both: 15 years' residence in Goa, knowledge of Konkani. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian citizens only. Minimum 15 years of residence in Goa (domicile). Knowledge of Konkani essential; knowledge of Marathi desirable.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications with incomplete information will be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview; call letters sent by email/SMS. Interview call letters will be sent by email/SMS. Candidates to check the college website for interviews and related matters.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Academic year 2026-27. Posts filled subject to availability of workload and approval of Goa University/DHE.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Dharbandora, Goa.
